errors.text_span: und steigt am Ende des Zeitraums stark an auf ungefähr 700
errors.evidence: The description states that the black line ("Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt") rises to approximately 700 at the end of the period. However, according to the left y-axis, the black line ends at a value of approximately 300. The value of approximately 650-700 corresponds to the end point of the light blue line ("Finanzpolitik").
